cards.headline: Mambilla project: Imoke insists contract award to Sunrise was invalid
cards.what_happened: Cross River State Governor Ben Ayade's predecessor-era opposition figure Imoke has insisted that the award of the Mambilla power project contract to Sunrise was invalid. The dispute centres on the validity of the contract award for the Mambilla hydropower project in Taraba State.
key_facts: Imoke insists the contract award to Sunrise for the Mambilla project was invalid.
analysis: Why it matters: A public challenge to the validity of a major hydropower contract award raises questions about procurement process and accountability for public money in Nigeria's power sector.

cards.headline: FG moves to regulate scrap metal industry, curb infrastructure vandalism
cards.what_happened: The Federal Government has moved to regulate the scrap metal industry in an effort to curb infrastructure vandalism.

cards.headline: Afreximbank, DBN partner on $75 million finance facility for SMEs, creative sector
cards.what_happened: Afreximbank and the Development Bank of Nigeria (DBN) have partnered on a $75 million finance facility aimed at small and medium-sized enterprises and the creative sector. The announcement was reported by Premium Times Nigeria. No further details on terms or timelines are provided in the available text.
key_facts: Afreximbank and DBN have partnered on a $75 million finance facility.
analysis: Why it matters: The facility channels development finance into Nigerian SMEs and creative businesses, which is relevant to lending access for these sectors. The available text does not state terms, disbursement arrangements or governance details.

cards.headline: UK backs Nigeria’s proposed $750m pension infrastructure fund
cards.what_happened: The United Kingdom has backed Nigeria's proposed $750 million pension infrastructure fund.
key_facts: The UK has backed Nigeria's proposed $750m pension infrastructure fund.
analysis: Why it matters: A government-backed pension infrastructure fund of this size could direct long-term capital into Nigerian projects, though the article gives no detail on its governance or ownership structure.

cards.headline: Certificate Forgery: Court adjourns ex-minister Uche Nnaji’s suit
cards.what_happened: A Nigerian court has adjourned a suit filed by former minister Uche Nnaji in a certificate forgery case. The report gives no further detail on the ruling or the next hearing date.
analysis: As reported by Premium Times; AURA has not checked court or agency records. An allegation or charge is not a finding of guilt.

also.text: The Minister has suspended reviews of broadcast licence fees and urged broadcasters to maintain the highest standards ahead of the 2027 elections.
